title: Waystations: Pilot Findings and Open Questions in KV-Cache Geometry
subtitle: Six pilot findings from the Oracle Loop program that merit independent investigation
abstract: Six pilot findings from the Oracle Loop program: trained censorship geometry, distillation fidelity, on-manifold steering constraints, strategic deception rates, hybrid attention architecture effects, and generation-phase engagement gradients. Each includes the observation, analysis, and what remains to be done. These are waystations, not claimed results.
